form: object: a book of IOUs on ledger paper

faces.label: Courier Prime
faces.reason: Besley is a Clarendon from 1845, the face of banknotes and IOUs. Libre Franklin is the gothic of printed forms. Courier Prime is what gets typed onto a slip.

accentFrom: the red ink of an OVERDUE stamp; used only for money still owed
material: pale green columnar ledger paper with a red double rule; white bond slips with perforated edges; one soft paper shadow, no borders
motion: paper slides out and settles; a stamp drops and bounces once
